messages._comment: RFC-MACP-0007 Section 2.1 Authority Matrix: Proposal is restricted to declared participants, and agent://outsider is not in the roster. FORBIDDEN rather than INVALID_ENVELOPE because the breach is sender authorization, per RFC-MACP-0002 Section 6.1.
RFC-MACP-0007 Section 5 rule 2: Objection MUST reference an existing proposal_id.

messages._comment: RFC-MACP-0007 Section 4: comparisons are case-sensitive, so recommendation "Approve" matches APPROVE only case-insensitively and is not a valid value. Placed before the first accepted Vote, so rule 6 (deliberation closes when voting begins) cannot be the cause.

RFC-MACP-0007 Section 4: Objection.severity values are lowercase, so "CRITICAL" is not a valid value and MUST NOT be treated as critical. Placed before the first accepted Vote, so rule 6 (deliberation closes when voting begins) cannot be the cause.

RFC-MACP-0007 Section 4: an empty severity is not one of low/medium/high/critical. No default exists, so it MUST be rejected rather than read as medium. Placed before the first accepted Vote, so rule 6 (deliberation closes when voting begins) cannot be the cause.

RFC-MACP-0007 Section 4: comparisons are case-sensitive, so vote "approve" is not a valid value. agent://b sends it, so that rule 3's one-vote-per-sender check cannot be the cause; agent://b casts no accepted Vote in this transcript.

RFC-MACP-0007 Section 5 rule 1: Proposal.proposal_id MUST be unique within the Session. p1 was accepted at index 1. The sender is a declared participant and no Vote has been accepted yet, so neither FORBIDDEN nor rule 6 can be the cause.

payload.rationale: a different option reusing an existing id

messages._comment: RFC-MACP-0007 Section 5 rule 2: Evaluation MUST reference an existing proposal_id. The recommendation is a valid value, so Section 4 cannot be the cause.

payload.reason: evaluating a proposal that was never submitted

messages._comment: RFC-MACP-0007 Section 5 rule 2: Vote MUST reference an existing proposal_id. agent://b casts no accepted Vote in this transcript, so rule 3 cannot be the cause, and a rejected Vote does not open the voting phase (RFC-MACP-0001 Section 8.3), so rule 6 does not start here.

payload.reason: voting on a proposal that was never submitted

messages._comment: RFC-MACP-0007 Section 4: MAYBE is not one of APPROVE, REJECT or ABSTAIN. This is an out-of-set value, not a casing variant, which the earlier vote case already covers.
RFC-MACP-0007 Section 2.1 Authority Matrix: Evaluation is restricted to declared participants. The payload is otherwise valid and references the live p1.
RFC-MACP-0007 Section 2.1: Objection is restricted to declared participants.
RFC-MACP-0007 Section 2.1: Vote is restricted to declared participants. Because the Vote is rejected, it neither opens the voting phase nor occupies a ballot slot.

RFC-MACP-0007 Section 5 rule 4: a runtime MUST reject Commitment from unauthorized senders. agent://a is a declared participant but not the initiator, and the bound policy's commitment authority does not extend to it. FORBIDDEN rather than INVALID_ENVELOPE because the breach is sender authorization, per RFC-MACP-0002 Section 6.1.
RFC-MACP-0007 Section 5 rule 3: a second, distinct Vote from a sender who already cast one for the same proposal_id MUST be rejected; the first accepted Vote stands.

payload.reason: changed my mind after re-reading the proposal

messages._comment: RFC-MACP-0007 Section 5 rule 6: deliberation closes when voting begins — an Evaluation arriving after the first accepted Vote MUST be rejected.

RFC-MACP-0007 Section 5 rule 6: an Objection arriving after the first accepted Vote MUST be rejected. Distinct from the rule-2 Objection case earlier in this transcript, which cites a proposal_id that never existed; this one cites the live p1 and comes from a declared participant, so neither a dangling reference nor FORBIDDEN can be the cause.

payload.reason: raising a blocking concern after balloting has already begun

messages._comment: RFC-MACP-0007 Section 5 rule 6: a Proposal arriving after the first accepted Vote MUST be rejected. The first accepted Vote fixes the option set, so a second option cannot be introduced once balloting has begun. Sender is a declared participant, so FORBIDDEN cannot be the cause.

payload.rationale: introducing a competing option after balloting has begun
